redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/prescan-python.test.mjs tests/prescan-node-backend.test.mjs tests/prescan-core.test.mjs tests/merge.test.mjs tests/agents.test.mjs tests/skill.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: no tally or error reader matched its output, so no line of it is quoted as decisive; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD; no ignored dependency directory linked from the project root; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home); deadline: 480s, the default - the command is not a sweep naming suites, so there is no recorded cost to size it from

outcome.technical: Prescan: generic.mjs gained scanEnvKeys (names only), scanClients (SDK constructors, base URLs, env:NAME or URL targets, no secrets) and importEdges (Python suffix-indexed and relative imports, JS/TS relative, at-alias and workspace package resolution); python.mjs gained envKeys, clients and queues (Celery/shared_task/Dramatiq/RQ/pika producers and consumers grouped by queue); node-backend.mjs and ts-frontend.mjs gained envKeys and clients. prescan.mjs adds extracts.generic.imports, areas[].extract and writes extracts/<area>.json next to --out (or --extracts <dir>): routes {method,path,handler,file,line}, tables with compact field strings, schemas, migrations, sqlTables, openapi, envKeys, queues {producers,consumers}, clients, httpCalls, stores, imports, cross-area links (import, http call to route, queue) on both sides; trimmed to EXTRACT_BUDGET=5500 chars with truncated counts. Measured: largest fixture slice 3825 chars (python-api app) + explorer brief 5735 = 9560 < 12000. merge.mjs: normaliseFragment (evidence lines number/L12-L14/line, string or missing level, missing paths/confidence, ops order) and caps 40/80/60/80 keeping the first elements and dropping dependants of dropped nodes/entities; meta.sources rows type truncation (area, dropped counts, note) and normalisation; an unreadable fragment file is recorded as a skipped area (extra, beyond the brief, to honour no re-ask); never exits 1 for caps. archmap-explorer.md: tools add Write, effort low, 20 tool-call budget, reads its extract file, writes the fragment to the brief path, exactly three-line reply. SKILL.md (333 lines, line 3 untouched): re-ask path removed, paths-only dispatch, three-line reply, extracts, exit-1 wording, profile table; model-schema.md and discovery-generic.md updated. Fixtures added under the widened scope: python-api app/config.py, tasks.py, jobs.py, node-api src/config.ts, books/books.service.ts, both READMEs. Existing tests updated for new skipped/truncated keys (py7, nb6, ts6), agents a1/a2, pc6 out dir. Full suite: node --test 313 pass 0 fail; node --test tests/denylist.test.mjs 2 pass; new files staged. Dependants: the three plug-in stack shims and e2e still correct (default exports and old keys unchanged; e2e green); prescan-core/node/python/ts tests, agents, skill, merge tests changed as above; SKILL.md dependants commands/evals/skill tests green, skills-lock.json only names other skills; docs/design.md D11 and lines 81, 125, 165 still say explorer medium effort and returns JSON fragments - STALE, not in this task's files, needs a follow-up edit.
